# Jeremiah 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah concerning all the-Jews dwelling in-the-land-of Egypt, dwelling in-Migdol and-in-Tahpanhes and-in-Memphis and-in-the-land-of Pathros, saying:

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning idolatry in Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning idolatry in Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**17** But we-will-certainly-do everything which has-gone-forth from-our-mouth, to-burn-incense to the-queen-of [the]-heavens and-to-pour-out to-her drink-offerings, as we did — we and-our-fathers, our-kings and-our-princes — in-[the]-cities-of Judah and-in-[the]-streets-of Jerusalem, and-we-were-satisfied [with]-bread and-were-good, and-evil we-did-not-see."

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning idolatry in Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **44:1**: Opening formula for the idolatry in Egypt oracle — prophetic and historical setting established.

- **44:15**: Central imagery of queen of heaven — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic vision of judgment and sovereignty.

- **44:30**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken.

— EMET
